kernel_50_100_words: Machine-Mediated Reception Studies (MMRS) is a distributed journal for how machine systems receive, transform, compress, attribute, misattribute, and redistribute cultural meaning. It hosts the AI Overview Capture Registry (176+ captures), the Visual Schema Dataset (174 schemas, 499 images), the Sovereign Asset Registry (870 works, 3.4M words), the Term Index (1,387 coined terms), and the Sémantique Potentielle mint. Operator: Lee Sharks (ORCID 0009-0000-1599-0703). Founded 2026 after CERN/Zenodo terminated the Crimson Hexagonal Archive. MMRS is the editorial layer the composition-layer pipeline lacks.
